abstract: PURPOSE: A seminomatous element in patients undergoing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer is associated with a desmoplastic reaction that renders retroperitoneal surgery more challenging. We examined the impact of seminomatous elements on the rate of complications and the need for additional intraoperative procedures in patients undergoing post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The testis cancer data base at our institution was retrospectively reviewed and 1,366 patients were identified who underwent post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection between 1973 and 2001. In 97 patients there was an element of seminoma in the dissection specimen and/or pure seminoma in the testicular primary specimen (seminoma group). The remaining 1,269 patients underwent post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for nonseminomatous testicular tumors. The rates of intraoperative complications and additional procedures as well as postoperative complications were analyzed. RESULTS: Of the 97 patients in the seminoma group 37 (38.1%) required a total of 47 additional intraoperative procedures, including 25 nephrectomies, 9 inferior vena caval resections, 5 arterial grafts, 5 bowel resections and 3 hepatic resections/biopsies, compared with 340 of the 1,269 patients (26.8%) in the group without seminomatous elements (p = 0.02). Postoperatively complications occurred in 24 of 97 patients (24.7%) in the seminoma group versus 257 of 1,269 (20.3%) in the group without seminomatous elements (p = 0.29). One of the 97 patients in the seminoma group died secondary to postoperative complications. CONCLUSIONS: A seminomatous element in patients undergoing post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection is associated with a higher rate of additional intraoperative procedures and postoperative complications than in patients without seminomatous elements. However, resection is still possible with acceptable morbidity when indicated in appropriately selected patients.
abstract_ja:
目的：セミノーマ成分を含む精巣がんでは、後腹膜に線維性反応を伴うため後腹膜手術が困難になる。化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた患者において、セミノーマ成分が合併症率と追加の術中処置の必要性に与える影響を検討した。
方法：当施設の精巣がんデータベースを後方視的に検討し、1973年から2001年の間に化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた1,366例を同定した。97例では郭清標本にセミノーマ成分があり、または精巣原発標本が純粋セミノーマであった（セミノーマ群）。残る1,269例は非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍に対して化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた。術中合併症と追加処置の発生率、および術後合併症を解析した。
結果：セミノーマ群97例中37例(38.1%)が計47件の追加術中処置を要した。内訳は腎摘出25件、下大静脈切除9件、動脈移植5件、腸切除5件、肝切除/生検3件であった。非セミノーマ群では1,269例中340例(26.8%)であった(p=0.02)。術後合併症はセミノーマ群97例中24例(24.7%)、非セミノーマ群1,269例中257例(20.3%)に発生した(p=0.29)。セミノーマ群の患者1例が術後合併症により死亡した。
結論：セミノーマ成分を含む化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清では、非セミノーマ群に比べ追加の術中処置および術後合併症の発生率が高い。ただし、適切に選択された患者では、必要に応じて許容可能な罹病率で切除は可能である。
